proposed.text: Per the mnemonic 'SS≠' for Section 904, what does it stand for?
proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: SS≠ = Storm Sewer ≠ Sanitary Sewer. They are parallel, separate, never-mixing infrastructure systems. Sky water (rain, roof runoff, area drains) → storm drain. Fixture water (grey water, black water from WCs) → sanitary drain. Never cross the streams.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096, Rule XII, Sec. 1212 / RA 9514 (Fire Code)
